what_it_does: This work develops algorithms and techniques for solving complex mathematical equations (partial differential equations or PDEs) that describe physical phenomena in multiple dimensions using quantum computers. Solving these equations is computationally challenging on classical computers, especially in high dimensions. The paper presents two different algorithmic approaches to improve accuracy and scalability: one using a straightforward numerical method, and another using a decomposition strategy that breaks the problem into smaller column-by-column pieces to enable better accuracy when running on quantum hardware.
